messages.en: What are you doing?
Yesterday, the air conditioner at the dorm stopped working.
It was so hot that I couldn't even fall asleep.
The room was practically like a sauna.
So I stayed in the living room drawing the whole time.
I drew Hexagoni fan art.
I took the positive image that comes to mind when I think of Hexagons
and turned it into a character.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
Last time,
I said I'd draw a Hexagons character,
and I remembered that,
so I drew it.
Hayeon, did you ever go to an art academy when you were little?!?!
Not really.
Ever since kindergarten,
I liked copying illustrations from storybooks
and things like that.
Maybe it's just a talent of mine ㅋ
The color of your mechanical pencil is Hayeon's color.
I bought the mint-colored one on purpose ㅎㅎㅎ
Do you get sentimental whenever you see mint?
I do feel a little sense of familiarity ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
These days, writing and drawing
have become my hobbies,
I really feel like a proper young lady,
and I look so elegant,
you know what I mean.
ㅎ핳하하하하ㅏㅏ
Does voice work now?
Where do I use it?
Eh.
It doesn't work.
It says I need to update~
I was going to go on a date with Y/n.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
크크킄ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
The update isn't showing up, though.
I'll do it before I come back next time.
I drew this one too.
It's not supposed to be anyone in particular.
I just drew whatever my hand felt like drawing.
Oh... it does kind of look like Yooyeon unnie.
It didn't take very long.
I think I spent about 10 minutes on each of them.
So they're still lacking in detail.
That's amazing. You're definitely more of an arts person.
Honestly, I feel that too.
Whenever someone tells me to study, I lose all motivation.

messages.ko: 잘한다 잘한다 해도 짜증만 나고 하기싫고
messages.en: Even if people praise me and tell me I'm doing well, I just get annoyed and don't want to do it.
I could never sit still in a chair.
So because I was like that,

messages.ko: 내가 뭐가되든 예체능쪽 하긴 하겠구나 싶었어
messages.en: I figured that no matter what I became, it'd probably be something in the arts.

messages.ko: 만우절 때 그렸던 그림이랑 비교하면 발전이 너무 큰 것 같아요!
messages.en: Compared to the drawing you did on April Fools', I think you've improved so much!
That was just for the concept~~
So whenever I had exams,

messages.ko: 애들은 시험지 비어있는곳을 풀이하느라 다 쓰는데
messages.en: everyone else would fill up the blank spaces on their test papers with their work,
but I'd be over there drawing instead.
By the end of the exam, my test paper was basically a sketchbook.
For exams, I usually relied on short-term memory.
I'd memorize everything that was likely to be on the test right before it started,
answer everything I knew as soon as I got the paper,
and then go to sleep.
I did work hard on Korean History, though.
It didn't really feel like studying—it was more like watching a drama.

messages.ko: 스토리 자체가 너무 기억에 남으니까 쉬웠고
messages.en: The stories themselves were so memorable that it made it easy.
What about Earth Science?? You're really interested in space, Hayeon.

messages.ko: 그건 문제만 흥미로워하고 답은 뭐 ㅎㅎ
messages.en: The questions are interesting, but the answers... well ㅎㅎ
I guess there's no need to even ask about mathㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Shh.
If I'm too perfect, I won't seem human ㅋ
What was your favorite subject?
I'm not sure about my favorite subject,
but I like Y/n.
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ
Recommend me something for dinner today!!

messages.ko: 나 방금 삼겹살에 볶음김치 먹었어 배달로
messages.en: I just had samgyeopsal and stir-fried kimchi delivered.

messages.ko: 시온이가 요즘 하연이 때문에 회 먹기 시작했다던데ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: I heard Sion started eating sashimi because of you these daysㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
That's right ㅋㅋㅎㅎㅋㅋㅋㅋ
We're family.
I ordered cheese buldak just for myself.
What if you suddenly develop a shellfish allergy?

messages.ko: 그럼 난 아무것도 먹을 수 없어…..
messages.en: Then I wouldn't be able to eat anything…..
That Yangzi Ganlu yesterday??
It was so delicious.
Since I'm not picky with food,
I'd always eat whatever the adults were eating.

messages.ko: 어린데 어른들 먹는 음식 먹는애가 나밖에 없으니까
messages.en: I was the only kid who ate grown-up food,
so they thought it was fascinating and kept buying food for me.

messages.ko: 할아버지가 광어 대짜리를 혼자 먹으라고 사주셔서
messages.en: My grandpa even bought me a large platter of flatfish just for me to eat.
I'd eat it until I got tired of it.

messages.ko: 원래 입주 초기 때 입 짧은 이미지였는데 어쩌다가 돼지력 아이돌이 된것인가...
messages.en: At the beginning after you moved in, you had the image of being a small eater. How did you end up becoming an idol with such a big appetite...
Back then, I weighed 44kg...

messages.ko: 지금 생각해보면 진짜 말랐었다 생각이 드네
messages.en: Thinking back now, I really was so skinny.
I can't say it now.
Was it yesterday?
At the fansign, I asked Nakyoung unnie,
"I've gained weight, haven't I?"
And then,
"You were always chubby~"
She said that, and I was so shocked.
I don't knowㅏㅏ
Honestly, I'm satisfied.
I've been happy eating!!
And I have Y/n who loves me just the way I am!!!
My body is healthy too!!!
How wonderful is that?
As long as we're happy~
Y/n, I hope you're happy too.
Don't get sick,
and I hope only good things happen to you.
The weather outside looks nice today too.
Have an energetic day,
I'll be cheering you on~
I'm off now.
Haranghae😍😍
